title: security.txt must contain an Expires field

spec.name: RFC 9116
spec.normative_quote: The "Expires" field indicates the date and time after which the data contained in the "security.txt" file is considered stale and should not be used. This field MUST always be present and MUST NOT appear more than once.
spec.note: Recalled from training-data familiarity with the published RFC, not re-verified against a live fetch this session (this agent has no WebFetch access). The deferred drift probe (ADR 0011 follow-up (h)) must reconcile this quote against a live re-fetch of spec.url before it is treated as verified -- see content_sha256's own description.

applicability: A security.txt body of any length.
expectation: The body contains at least one line matching /^Expires:\s*\S/ (case-insensitive).

cases.name: Expires present (comfortably in the future) -- this rule does not fire
